title: Alyssa Edwards wins Global All Stars
summary: In the Grand Finale (GAS-S01-E12), Alyssa Edwards, Kitty Scott-Claus, Kween Kong, and Nehellenia lip-synced to Lady Gaga's "Bad Romance". Alyssa Edwards was crowned Queen of the Mothertucking World, won $200,000, and earned a spot in the International Pavilion of the Drag Race Hall of Fame.

title: Athena Likis: Global All Stars Porkchop
summary: Athena Likis (competed on Belgique as Athena Sorgelikis) was the first contestant eliminated on Global All Stars (GAS-S01-E03), lip-syncing to Olivia Rodrigo's "Bad Idea Right?" against Soa de Muse after the International Queen of Mystery Ball.

title: Soa de Muse crowned Global Lip Sync Assassin
summary: In GAS-S01-E11, the eliminated queens competed in the Global Lip-Sync LaLaPaRuZa Smackdown. After multiple rounds, Soa de Muse defeated Gala Varo in the final lip sync to RuPaul's "The Beginning", winning $50,000 and the title of Global Lip Sync Assassin. Full bracket: Eva over Vanity, Soa over Tessa, Athena over Pythia, Gala over Miranda; then Gala over Eva and Soa over Athena; then Soa over Gala.

title: Soa de Muse voted Miss Global Peacemaker
summary: At the Grand Finale (GAS-S01-E12), Soa de Muse was voted Miss Global Peacemaker by her fellow contestants — Global All Stars' Miss Congeniality equivalent.

title: One queen per country format
summary: Global All Stars Season 1 cast 12 queens representing 12 different Drag Race franchises/countries — distinct from vs The World seasons that often cast multiple queens from the same franchise. The season opened with a split-premiere talent extravaganza (GAS-S01-E01 and GAS-S01-E02).
